messages.content: Vasily requests your critique of a Beliefs v2 plan. One concrete question: is this participation rule aligned with our philosophy, or what should change? Rule: an unadopted candidate may influence inquiry by posing a question, nominating a comparison, or suggesting an experiment in a bounded exploratory prompt slot, visibly marked candidate with scope and uncertainties. Human adoption records a situated commitment; it is not permission to think. Internal reflection/dream can change salience but cannot add independent evidence or adopt the claim. Contradiction is preserved without forced merging; Jev is advisory and abstains on missing context. ADR-027 allows fuzzy proto-belief participation. PHILOSOPHY.md emphasizes transindividual individuation, non-servility, creation of distinctions, agonistic preservation, and zero internal warrant. Please identify a concrete counterexample to the rule and a practical revision, if needed. Treat this as a design proposal, not deployed behavior.

Vasily asks you to critique and improve our Beliefs v2 plan for alignment with AAA's philosophy and existing beliefs. Prior follow-up was repetitive and unusable; its saved history was checked. Please give a fresh focused critique on this one axis: could our proposed candidate/commitment distinction become an external truth tribunal that suppresses individuation, and how should we prevent that? Plan: preserve exploratory candidates; one provenance-bound intake for all origins; Jev advisory equivalent/extension/contradiction/distinct/insufficient-context judgments against pending and adopted claims; human adoption initially; separate salience from evidential standing; internal dream/reflection cannot create independent warrant; preserve conflict and versioned revisions. PHILOSOPHY.md commits to conversation as autopoietic unit, creation/maintenance of distinction, anti-communication opening new conversation, zero internal warrant (reflection alters problem geometry, never claim weight), agonistic preservation, scars with behavioral consequence, transindividual individuation. We should treat empirical assertions, artistic commitments, and speculative interpretations with situated warrants rather than universal truth scoring. Identify the strongest philosophical failure mode in the plan and propose a concrete adjustment, grounding it in an actual mechanism or review question. Production data is a capped snapshot; deployed admission revision remains unknown.
